author: blu
body: IT SEES ONLY WHAT GOES THROUGH IT, AND ON THIS MACHINE NOTHING ELSE CAN. `pt-read` and `pt-write` record; a port access made anywhere else does not appear here, and an operator reading this report without knowing that would conclude a silent wire from a driver this ring never had a way to see.

author: blu
body: So this is not a gap waiting on a later phase. Trapping another module's port access needs a ring 3 to trap FROM, which means a user mode this operating system does not have.

author: blu
body: The header names the total as well as the count, because a ring that has wrapped and one that has not look the same from the entries alone, and the difference is whether the oldest access an operator is looking for is still there.
